verdict.rationale: Chroma's own marketing lists point-in-time recovery (alongside BYOC and replication), and Chroma Cloud offers copy-on-write collection forking for dataset versioning. A fork works as a snapshot-like copy of a collection. However, there is no documented snapshot backup and restore workflow, and PITR gets only a single marketing mention with no docs on how to trigger a restore. Missing for 10: a documented snapshot/backup API or CLI command, documented restore procedure, coverage for self-hosted OSS deployments, and independent or hands-on corroboration of backup/restore.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can back up collections with snapshots and restore them

citations.quote: BYOC in your VPC, multi-cloud/multi-region replication, point-in-time-recovery ensure a resilient and scalable search system
